view3: ขยาย ป1 / ป2 1:20 (ประตู) — architectural details, not extracted (op04)
warnings: T1 is drawn as a half truss (eave to just past the ridge): top chord 'จันทันเหล็ก ⊓⊓-150x50x50x4.5 มม.', bottom chord 'เหล็ก ⊔-150x50x50x4.5 มม.', webs 'ตุ๊กตาและค้ำยันเหล็ก 2L-50x50x3 มม. คู่', panels 1.00, eave 0.95 + 0.95. The third number of '150x50x50' does not fit a standard lipped channel (kept verbatim; only d/b go in steel_section), same oddity as house 129. Per-member list uses the attribute key member_sections (house 129 precedent).
T2 chord thickness glyph reads like 5 (the web label's 3 is drawn differently) — 'L-50x50x5' taken with the thickness left out of steel_section and the doubt flagged; T2 depth printed '≈0.80'.

Gable beam B: section ก-ก (mid-span) top 2Ø12, bottom 2Ø12 + 2Ø12 ค.ม. L/5; section ข-ข (support) top 4Ø12, bottom 2Ø12 — the 4Ø12 at the support are the 2 continuous + 2 bent-up bars. Bent-up bars merged into bottom (house 129 convention); the support reading kept in the note.
RC fin at the gable eave ('ครีบ ค.ส.ล. หนา 0.10', 1.90 long x 1.20 high, two Ø6 meshes @0.15 / @0.10) has no mark → element_id null.
Purlins are labelled on the T1 detail; the tail of the purlin callout (fixing) is illegible.
